zh.title: 西班牙批准與波蘭合購至少七架A330 MRTT空中加油機
zh.summary: 西國批准七年框架協議；波蘭2030年前取得四架
body: 西班牙政府已授權與波蘭共同採購至少七架空中巴士A330 MRTT（Multi Role Tanker Transport）空中加油機，其中四架預計在2030年前交付波蘭空軍。據AeroTime報導，西班牙部長會議於2026年8月25日批准此框架協議，估算金額為54億歐元（約63億美元），涵蓋機體及服役所需的後勤支援。
波蘭將透過以歐盟「歐洲安全行動」（SAFE）機制融資的一項增補協議參與。波蘭副總理兼國防部長Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz表示，協議涵蓋「至少七架」空中巴士A330 MRTT，波蘭將在2030年前取得四架；他並補充，下一步是簽署最終協議。
西班牙與波蘭曾於2026年5月29日簽署備忘錄。2026年6月23日柯氏訪問馬德里及空中巴士Getafe改裝中心時表示，雙方正進入實行階段，但尚需確認機數與產能。
波蘭認為國家空中加油機隊對於發揮其引進中的F-35A戰機的航程與續航力至關重要。SAFE提供多達1500億歐元（約1740億美元）的長期貸款資金用於歐洲國防採購，空中加油與戰略運輸皆為符合資格的項目。
新機將補充西班牙現有的三機A330 MRTT計畫；其首架改裝加油機已於2025年4月於第45聯隊服役。兩國尚未確認新一批將採用既有的A330-200或以A330-800為基礎的MRTT+版本。

en.title: Spain approves at least seven Airbus A350 MRTT tankers with four bound for Poland
en.summary: Spain backs joint purchase of at least seven Airbus A330 MRTT tankers; Poland to receive 4 by 2030
body: Spain has authorized a seven-year framework agreement for the joint acquisition of at least seven Airbus A330 Multi-Role Tanker Transport (MRTT) aircraft with Poland, including four for the Polish Air Force by 2030, according to AeroTime.

The Spanish Council of Ministers approved the framework on August 25, 2026, with an estimated value of €5.4 billion ($6.3 billion). It covers the aircraft and the logistical support needed to bring them into service.

Poland will participate through an addendum financed under the European Union's Security Action for Europe (SAFE) instrument. Polish Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamys said the arrangement covered "at least seven" Airbus A330 MRTTs and that Poland would receive four by 2030, adding that the next step would be the signature of the final agreement.

Spain and Poland signed a memorandum on May 29, 2026. During a visit to Madrid and Airbus' Getafe conversion center on June 23, 2026, Kosiniak-Kamys said the countries were moving into the implementation phase but still had to settle aircraft numbers and production capacity.

Poland considers a national tanker fleet essential to exploit the range and endurance of its incoming F-35A fighters. SAFE provides up to €150 billion ($174 billion) in long-term loans for European defense procurement, with air-to-air refueling and strategic transport among eligible capabilities.

The new aircraft would supplement Spain's existing three-aircraft A330 MRTT program, whose first converted tanker entered service with the 45th Wing in April 2025. Neither country has confirmed whether the new batch will use the established A330-200 or the A330-800-based MRTT+ version.

zh.title: 合格但缺乏經驗 新晉飛行員求職難
zh.summary: 航空業招聘趨向審慎；新晉機師雖合資格仍難獲聘
body: Aerospace Global News 報道，航空業正面對一個明顯矛盾：一方面長遠就業前景強勁，另一方面新晉飛行員發現完成培訓、取得執照和累計飛行時數已不再保證能獲得職位。
報道指，疫後招聘熱潮已消退，航空公司對招聘對象變得更具選擇性。許多新晉機師面對「經驗門檻」，即使完全符合資格、受過專業訓練且法律上可執業飛行，仍可能因缺乏航空公司認為理想的經驗而在應徵副駕駛席時落選。
報道亦列出長期需求預測，包括波音估計全球航空業未來二十年需要數百萬新航空專業人員；培訓機構 CAE 則估計到二零三四年全球約需三十萬名新機師。文章強調長期勞動力需求與短期招聘需求之間存在區別。

en.title: Newly qualified pilots face experience barrier as airline hiring turns more selective
en.summary: Post-pandemic pilot hiring boom fades; airlines more selective, favouring extra hours and experience
body: Aerospace Global News reports the aviation industry faces an apparent contradiction: long-term employment prospects remain strong, yet newly qualified pilots are finding that completing training, earning licences and building flight hours no longer guarantee a job.

The post-pandemic hiring boom has faded, and airlines are becoming more selective, according to the report. A pilot can be fully qualified and legally entitled to fly commercially but still lack the experience an airline considers desirable for an entry-level position.

Long-term demand is expected to remain significant: Boeing forecast the global aviation industry will require millions of new aviation professionals over the next two decades, and training organisation CAE has estimated around 300,000 new pilots will be needed globally by 2034.
